## Design

### 2026-10-07 – Notes along the way:

**1.03h**

Notes along the way:
I learned that KiCad has these important functionalities
- Q for X's unused connection pins
- R to rotate
- L for net labels

Screen to microcontroller
- SCL is clock line for synchronization
- SDA is data line to D6
- XIAO - ESP32 - C3 - SMD

Resources that I found useful

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/3eb39ef0-b7df-4794-9d24-56aa4999135c/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-11 – finished the schematic for starbie!

**1h**

finished the schematic for starbie!
